versions.name: Oasis
versions.text: Send your hand to your deck. Add 6 Change of Winds to your hand. Delay: Burn any still in your hand to heal 3 HP for each.

versions.name: Oasis
versions.text: Send your hand to your deck. Add 6 1-cost Change of Winds to your hand. Delay: Burn them to heal 3 HP for each burned.
versions.note: Also includes Beta 101.0 (the tracker saw them together).

versions.name: Oasis
versions.text: Add 3 Changes of Winds to your hand. Delay: Erase all Changes of Winds in your hand to heal 4 HP to you for each.
